It does not release pool slots or update global count. 00512C80 walks the original head/next chain, clears each visited occupancy low nibble and writes cached global count minus visited length (mod256) once at the end, then performs the same inline reset. Empty headFF skips global-counter read/write.

facts.ownership: Inline reset cannot substitute for linked release when active owned nodes must be reclaimed. Calling reset on a nonempty owner discards its owner links without clearing those nodes. This is a local effect under a forced premise, not evidence of an actual faulty caller.

Under those premises n<=32 and final globalcount=(old-n)&FF; ownercount reset does not validate actual list length.
